title: Cosmic Mushroom Sorceress
description: A vibrant psychedelic female figure with green skin and long lime hair wears a red headwrap adorned with flowers. She holds glowing blue orbs connected by chains while standing behind an enormous, intricately detailed mushroom whose cap contains a swirling galaxy. Smaller mushrooms and lush foliage surround the base against a dark space background filled with stars and spiral galaxies.
prompt: Psychedelic fantasy scene of a green-skinned sorceress with long flowing lime hair and red headwrap decorated with flowers, holding glowing blue orbs on chains. She stands behind a giant colorful mushroom whose cap is filled with a swirling galaxy and stars. Smaller mushrooms and vibrant foliage at the base, set against a dark cosmic background with spiral galaxies and glowing energy lines in a highly detailed vibrant style.
